File went 1268 -> 1331 lines. `git status --porcelain` shows only ` M docs/anti-patterns.md` from me (`?? docs/issues/ISS-0227.yaml` is ISSUE-FIXER's own untracked file, not mine).

At HEAD 66c6898 (REVIEWER measured at 7b880a1; three further commits have landed since, but none touched this file): `grep -n` confirms :1195 is `## A grep-shaped acceptance criterion can be tripped by the module's own moduledoc describing the invariant`, :1222 is the closing 'Correct alternative' line ending `...independent facts about the same file.`, :1224 is `## A migration version can collide with a test fixture's hardcoded version constant, not just another migration file`, and the file was 1268 lines with that migration entry last. Every figure in REVIEWER's two `location` fields is correct as written. No relocation by heading text was needed.

=== 2. INSERTION POINTS ACTUALLY USED ===

ENTRY A: inserted after original line 1222, before original line 1223 (the blank separator preceding the `## A migration version...` heading). Written as blank line + 31 lines of text, so entry A now occupies :1223-:1254, the `## A migration version...` heading moved 1224 -> 1256, and the amended grep-shaped entry now runs :1195-:1254 with its original body byte-identical at :1195-:1222.

  Same pattern restricted to code, `git grep -nE "owner_pid:|schema_name: op_schema_name|op_schema_name" -- 'lib/**/*.ex' 'test/**/*.exs'` -> no output, exit 1. Zero lines of code, exactly as REVIEWER reported.

    (d) Added a parenthetical that `docs/anti-patterns.md` is now itself a third such medium, because THIS ENTRY quotes both removed identifiers in order to document them -- so writing the entry adds the file to its own match set. REVIEWER's 'Two of those media are ones the entry above does not contemplate' is kept verbatim and the third is stated separately rather than by editing its sentence.

  Nothing else in either exact_text was altered in wording; both were hard-wrapped to the file's ~90-column convention (line breaks only, no word changed), and the fenced code block was left unwrapped.
